name: Tommy Muldoon
title: The Rookie Cop
ability:
[reaction] When an asset you control is defeated: Gain X resources, where X is the total amount of damage and horror on that asset. Shuffle that asset into your deck.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Tommy Muldoon to an asset you control, or vice versa.
ability_cn:
[reaction]在你控制的一张支援卡被击败时：获得X资源，X为该支援卡上的伤害和恐惧的总和。将该支援卡混洗入你的牌堆。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将托米·马尔登上的最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到你控制的1张支援卡上，或将你控制的1张支援卡上的最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到托米·马尔登上。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Tommy Muldoon to an asset you control, or vice versa.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将托米·马尔登上的最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到你控制的1张支援卡上，或将你控制的1张支援卡上的最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到托米·马尔登上。
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Becky, Rookie Mistake, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：守卫者([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，求生者cards([survivor])等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：贝基、低级错误、1张随机基础弱点。
